name: Climb Cubs
summary:
Climb Cubs is a FREE co-op climbing game where you need to manage your resources, look for new animals, and make your way to the top! Get ready to explore and scale new peaks!

Be sure to join our Discord to look for fellow climbers as well as updates! 
https://discord.gg/u6zHJYJDt4
